# Jaime Summers

> AI director based in Barcelona. Directs commercials, short films and music pieces made with generative AI, from first idea to final mix. 23 years in music, scoring, mixing and Spanish dubbing for film and TV.

## Services
- Direction: commercials, short films, music
- AI workflow consulting for production teams

## Selected work
- Swatch · A World in Every Color (spec, not commissioned by the brand, 30", 2026)
- Eat Well (spec, 34", 2026)
- Honda · Never Be Late (spec, not commissioned by the brand, 30", 2026)
- Copenhague · Launch Promo (client: Copenhague, indie band, 52", 2026)

## Background
- Spanish dubbing (recording, editing, QC, mix) through Deluxe and VSI Script International for Netflix, HBO, Disney+, Apple TV+, Prime Video, Paramount+ and TV3
- Original score: Vuela (animated short, Goya nominee) and La novia de América (film)
- Music and sound for advertising campaigns through OEO & Parser, Trafalgar 13 and as a freelancer
